research_project.question: What is HEY's current research view of this project?
research_project.returns: Identity, builder state, the latest meaningful change and recent changes, contract identity, market and usage context (context only), tagged claims from the Research Summary, unknowns, freshness and evidence ids.

params.name: project
params.description: A published project slug, e.g. "agentos" (this, q or address — exactly one). An old slug that redirects answers as the project it moved to.

params.name: slug
params.description: The same as project (2026-11-08, additive): the name /api/projects/{slug} uses. Send project or slug, not both.

params.name: q
params.description: A project name or $TICKER (2–64 characters), resolved through HEY’s project search: one exact match answers, several answer status ambiguous (HTTP 200) with a candidates list and no pick, none is not_found. Never a guess.

params.name: address
params.description: A 0x contract address on Robinhood Chain: the published project HEY records it under.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Default and only accepted value: 4663, Robinhood Chain.

research_project.never: A price view, a ranking by return or a recommendation.

what_changed.question: What changed with this project, or on Robinhood Chain, in the last N days?
what_changed.returns: Canonical change-ledger events in the window, with the true total by type and how many count as building; the events shown lead with those that count as building, each group newest first, each event with its own time, precision, when HEY knew and its evidence.

params.name: project
params.description: A project slug; omit for the whole chain (projects building on Robinhood Chain).

params.name: days
params.description: 1–30; default 7. The window is on when the event happened, or when HEY detected it where no source dates it.

params.name: types
params.description: Change types to keep, comma-separated (build.release, build.ship, build.resumed …).

params.name: limit
params.description: 1–50 events shown; default 25. The total is always the whole window.

params.name: building
params.description: "only": events that count toward activity status (the ledger’s countsAsBuilding), leaving out market readings and HEY’s own records.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Default and only accepted value: 4663, Robinhood Chain.

what_changed.never: A cause: an event beside a market move is a sequence.

builder_status.question: Is this project still building, and why does HEY say so?
builder_status.returns: The activity status with its methodology version, the inputs it read, the lineage from source to public value, the supporting evidence, the context the rule excludes (price, market cap, liquidity, volume, holders, usage, paid promotion, $HEY), freshness and unknown inputs.

params.name: project
params.description: A published project slug, e.g. "agentos" (this, q or address — exactly one). An old slug that redirects answers as the project it moved to.

params.name: slug
params.description: The same as project (2026-11-08, additive): the name /api/projects/{slug} uses. Send project or slug, not both.

params.name: q
params.description: A project name or $TICKER (2–64 characters), resolved through HEY’s project search: one exact match answers, several answer status ambiguous (HTTP 200) with a candidates list and no pick, none is not_found. Never a guess.

params.name: address
params.description: A 0x contract address on Robinhood Chain: the published project HEY records it under.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Default and only accepted value: 4663, Robinhood Chain.

builder_status.never: Investment advice: a building status is a record of development, not a view on the token.

verify_project.question: Does this contract or token appear to belong to this project?
verify_project.returns: VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, CONTRACT_MISMATCH or UNKNOWN, with the reason code, the reasons in words, the project HEY records the contract under and how.

params.name: address
params.description: A 0x contract address on Robinhood Chain.

params.name: project
params.description: The project slug the caller believes it belongs to.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Default and only accepted value: 4663, Robinhood Chain.

verify_project.never: A safety verdict: VERIFIED means the project itself names the contract, never that it is safe.

compare_builders.question: How do these projects' building records compare over 30 days?
compare_builders.returns: Two to four projects side by side on factual builder metrics (status, last meaningful ship, counted ships this 30 days and the 30 before, release cadence, active weeks, Build Momentum, verification) with each one’s peer cohort; no winner, no order but the one asked. Fewer than two found is not_found (too_few_projects_found); a comparison with one missing says partial.

params.name: projects
params.description: Two to four project slugs, comma-separated.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Default and only accepted value: 4663, Robinhood Chain.

compare_builders.never: A better investment, a winner or a combined score.

unknowns.question: What does HEY not know about this project or token?
unknowns.returns: Every gap as UNKNOWN, NOT_MEASURED, NOT_VERIFIED, STALE or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, with the dimension, a reason code, what HEY lacks and what an agent must not conclude from it; and the dimensions HEY did measure.

params.name: project
params.description: A project slug (this, q or address — exactly one).

params.name: slug
params.description: The same as project (2026-11-08, additive): the name /api/projects/{slug} uses. Send project or slug, not both.

params.name: q
params.description: A project name or $TICKER (2–64 characters), resolved through HEY’s project search: one exact match answers, several answer status ambiguous (HTTP 200) with a candidates list and no pick, none is not_found. Never a guess.

params.name: address
params.description: A token or contract address, when the caller holds no slug.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Default and only accepted value: 4663, Robinhood Chain.

unknowns.never: Negative evidence: a gap is what HEY does not hold, never a finding about the project.

chain_brief.question: What is happening on Robinhood Chain this week?
chain_brief.returns: The rolling week as /api/this-week counts it — ships and the projects behind them, new Verified Builders, status recoveries, Still Building and Under the Radar held today, each with its method — and the newest changes that count as building in the same window (what each code week shipped), with the true total and where to read on.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Default and only accepted value: 4663, Robinhood Chain.

chain_brief.never: A market reading, a ranking or a pick: a count of what HEY recorded, never a view on any token.
